desc: Derive reduction: pairing optimum = best even-count color assignment of M=2K items maximizing sum of assigned coordinates; answer = V − OPT.
Prove min-fix is a single {a,b} op or a disjoint {a,c}+{b,c} pair; implement baseline (top-M by m_i) + O(N log N) min-fix solver.
Run `python3 solution.py stress` (exhaustive binary N<=5, ternary N=3, 4000 random incl. ties/duplicates/zeros/1e9/color-spread) and paste raw stdout; on MISMATCH report the exact counterexample.
Run `python3 solution.py perf` (T=1000, sum N=1e5, K=N//2, 1e9 values); confirm runtime is reasonable.
If a mismatch surfaces, patch the offending op/exclusion branch (A2/A3/A4, B2/B3/B4, 2nd-best gaps) and re-run stress until "all ok"; if the same case keeps failing, switch reduction.
Finalize: mark done only after stress passes with no mismatch.
